extracted.name: ABC Pudding - Avocado, Banana, Chocolate Delight
extracted.description: This raw and vegan pudding is made with avocado, banana, and cocoa powder pureed for a creamy and refreshing treat.
ingredient_lines: 0.25 cup unsweetened cocoa powder, plus more for garnish
instruction_lines: Place avocados, bananas, and cocoa powder in a blender; puree until smooth.
Pour pudding into serving bowls and sprinkle additional cocoa powder on top for garnish.
Chill in refrigerator for texture and flavor to develop, at least 1 hour.
